title: oreocharis rosthornii var. xingrenensis
intro: Oreocharis rosthornii var. xingrenensis, commonly known as Oreocharis xingrenensis, is a plant species in the genus Oreocharis, native to China. As a traditional medicinal plant, Oreocharis xingrenensis has been used in Chinese medicine to treat various health issues. The plant has been reported to possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Oreocharis xingrenensis include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, pain relief, and anti-inflammatory effects.
